name: observability
description: Observability/audit contracts (W061): the typed TELEMETRY + AUDIT vocabulary — closed operational event-kind sets with typed payloads and DECLARED timestamps (A9: no clocks, no randomness, no env reads), the immutable append-only AuditRecord contract citing W028 provenance (an audit record without provenance is refused), hash-chained trail digests as data, and the explicit tenant/project/world scope on every record (§14). Contracts only (A14): composes typed records — never scrapes, never serves, never alerts.
